title: Accidental SOS vs Destination Assist
vehicle: 2024 Grand Highlander, Drive Connect trial active
location: Parked in a shopping-center lot, occupants answering
coverage: Safety Connect and Drive Connect trials active

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Safety Connect emergency. Is anyone hurt?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: No, I am fine. I did not mean to hit the SOS button. I meant to call Destination Assist. I just need a restaurant near me.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I am glad you are safe. This SOS line is for emergencies. I will confirm there is no crash, then we will get Destination Assist on the correct channel.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Sorry. Can you just send the restaurant into my navigation from here?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I will not keep an emergency line for a restaurant. I can transfer you to Destination Assist, or you can say Call Destination Assist from the nav menu.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Okay, please transfer me. I did not mean to clog the emergency line.
